question: The average of first 151 odd natural numbers, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **average** of the first **n** **odd natural numbers** is always **n**.

Given **n = 151**.

∴ Average = 151.

**∴ The correct answer is 151.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of terms (**n**) = 151

The sequence of first 151 odd numbers is 1, 3, 5, ..., **l**

**Formula Used:**

Average of an **Arithmetic Progression (AP)** = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2

Last term (**l**) of **n** odd numbers = 2**n** − 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3502a744736789d022b4feea91756e447856cefef8c828cb7e5d0bcaa51428f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First term (**a**) = 1

⇒ Last term (**l**) = 2 × 151 − 1 = 302 − 1 = 301

⇒ Average = (1 + 301) ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 302 ÷ 2

⇒ Average = 151

**∴ The correct answer is 151.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of First n Odd Numbers

The sum of the first **n** odd natural numbers is always **n²**.

Average of First n Even Numbers

The average of the first **n** even natural numbers is **(n + 1)**.

Average of First n Natural Numbers

The average of the first **n** natural numbers (1, 2, 3...n) is **(n + 1) ÷ 2**.</p
